# jambonz_sip_gateway (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jambonz_sip_gateway" "fastco_east" {
  voip_carrier_sid = jambonz_voip_carrier.fastco.voip_carrier_sid

  ipv4    = "198.51.100.10"
  port    = 5060
  netmask = 32

  inbound  = true
  outbound = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ipv4` (String)
- `voip_carrier_sid` (String) voip carrier that provides this gateway

### Optional

- `inbound` (Boolean)
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `netmask` (Number) CIDR prefix length for the gateway network
- `outbound` (Boolean)
- `port` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `sip_gateway_sid` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# The import ID is the sip_gateway_sid.
terraform import jambonz_sip_gateway.example 9d26a637-1679-471f-8da8-7150266e1254
```
